fusions.name: Lead-Weighted Tip
fusions.desc: Swings a weighted tip that deals 36 damage, ignoring the target's armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Ring
fusions.desc: Brings the lash down in a ring that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and [Stuns] each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Forging Rhythm
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Dented Plate
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
